dashboard.label: Device
dashboard.description: Vendor-neutral device status — battery level, charge state, charging sessions and hardware info (Wearables data model)

| search device_id="$device$"
| sort _time
| dedup _raw
| eval level=battery_level
| eval is_charging_evt=if(charging="true" OR on_charger="true", 1, 0)
| streamstats reset_on_change=true window=1 current=false last(is_charging_evt) as prev_charging_evt
| eval session_start=if(is_charging_evt=1 AND (prev_charging_evt=0 OR isnull(prev_charging_evt)), 1, 0)
| streamstats sum(session_start) as session_id
| where is_charging_evt=1
| stats earliest(_time) as start_time latest(_time) as end_time earliest(level) as level_start latest(level) as level_end count as samples by session_id
| eval duration_min=round((end_time-start_time)/60,1)
| eval start_str=strftime(start_time,"%b %d %H:%M")
| eval end_str=strftime(end_time,"%b %d %H:%M")
| eval level_gained=level_end-level_start
| sort -start_time
| head 10
| table start_str, end_str, duration_min, level_start, level_end, level_gained

| eval status=if(setup_raw==newest,"current","retired")
| eval color=replace(color,"_"," ")
| eval setup=substr(setup_raw,1,10)
| eval age_days=round((now()-strptime(setup,"%Y-%m-%d"))/86400,0)
| sort -setup_raw
| table hw, fw, size, color, setup, age_days, status

- **Charge Status** — current battery level, whether it’s on the charger, and how long since the last sync.
- **Time to Empty (est.)** — a lightweight projection from the recent discharge rate (median %/hr while not charging). Not a trained model — treat as a rough guide.
- **Avg Discharge Rate** — median battery drop per hour over the selected range (charging periods excluded).
- **Battery Level Trend** — battery percentage over the selected time range.
- **Charging Sessions** — recent charge cycles: when, how long, and % gained.
- **Rings on this Account** — every ring set up on this Oura account (current + retired): hardware, firmware, size, color, setup date and age. Battery, sleep and other metrics are account-level (Oura reports them for the active ring), so they aren’t split per ring.
